Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Ko Phi Phi Leh (Maya Bay) is in Phuket Province, mis-synthesizing the retrieved information. Ko Phi Phi Leh is in Krabi Province. Although later corrected, this was the first factual error and reflects a misinterpretation/assumption during consolidation.
